text.es: Fina: ¿No es nuestra vida ya una condena? Marta: Poder estar contigo no es una condena. Sentir el calor de tu piel no es una condena. Poder besarte no es una condena. Para mí amarte es vivir y lo demás me da igual.
text.en: Fina: Isn't our life already a sentence? Marta: Being able to be with you is not a sentence. Feeling the warmth of your skin is not a sentence. Being able to kiss you is not a sentence. For me, loving you is living, and everything else I don't care about.
